collection.description: A child sees an elder cry during a joyful reunion.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) sees (elder) cry during a joyful reunion.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a caregiver, says strong happiness can bring tears.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that tears do not always mean sadness.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (elder) says they missed their family very much.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (elder) prefers a hug to an explanation.

text_only.reason: a celebration talked about or planned in the story; nobody celebrates in the game -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) laughs at how surprising emotions can be.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) gives (elder) space to enjoy the moment.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) offers a flower without asking questions.
